'''Tajikarao Shrine''' (手力雄神社, also read Tejikarao Shrine) refers to shrines dedicated to {{ill|Ame-no-Tajikarao|ja|天手力雄神・天手力男神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Tajikarao|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. Multiple shrines share this name.

* {{ill|Tajikarao Shrine (Tateyama City)|ja|手力雄神社 (館山市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tajikarao Shrine (Tateyama City)}} (たぢからおじんじゃ) - Located in {{ill|Tateyama, Chiba|en|Tateyama, Chiba|qid=Q646755|lt=Tateyama City|1=Tateyama, Chiba}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture|1=Chiba Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Tejikarao Shrine|en|Tejikarao Shrine|qid=Q3517214|lt=Tajikarao Shrine|1=Tejikarao Shrine}} (てぢからおじんじゃ) - Located in {{ill|Gifu|en|Gifu|qid=Q45798|lt=Gifu City|1=Gifu}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|en|Gifu Prefecture|qid=Q131277|lt=Gifu Prefecture|1=Gifu Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Tejikaraō Shrine (Kakamigahara)|ja|手力雄神社 (各務原市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tejikaraō Shrine (Kakamigahara)}} (てぢからおじんじゃ) - Located in {{ill|Kakamigahara|en|Kakamigahara|qid=Q641491|lt=Kakamigahara City|1=Kakamigahara}}, Gifu Prefecture.
* {{ill|Tejikarao Shrine (Ōgaki)|ja|手力雄神社 (大垣市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tejikarao Shrine (Ōgaki)}} (てぢからおじんじゃ) - Located in {{ill|Ōgaki|en|Ōgaki|qid=Q384926|lt=Ōgaki City|1=Ōgaki}}, Gifu Prefecture.
* {{ill|Tajikarao Shrine (Nara City)|ja|手力雄神社 (奈良市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tajikarao Shrine (Nara City)}} (たぢからおじんじゃ) - Located in {{ill|Nara (city)|en|Nara (city)|qid=Q169134|lt=Nara City|1=Nara (city)}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|en|Nara Prefecture|qid=Q131287|lt=Nara Prefecture|1=Nara Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Tajikarao Shrine (Sakurai City)|ja|手力雄神社 (桜井市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tajikarao Shrine (Sakurai City)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (たぢからおじんじゃ) - Located in {{ill|Sakurai, Nara|en|Sakurai, Nara|qid=Q127026|lt=Sakurai City|1=Sakurai, Nara}}, Nara Prefecture.
